♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through sidereal Aquarius in Dhanishtha, activating your 11th house of allies, aspirations and future gains while answering to Saturn in Pisces in your 12th. This gives a mix of social buzz and private introspection: you’re outwardly engaged, yet inwardly sorting through which dreams still feel alive. Mars, your ruler, continues in late Cancer in your 4th, stirring action around home, family and emotional security, while the Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo energise your 6th house of work and health. This is a day of pruning: refining your routines and networks so they truly support your long-term direction.

💼 Career: The 11th-house Moon favours teamwork, professional communities and long-range planning. Group discussions can suddenly clarify which projects are worth your late nights and which aren’t. With Sun and retrograde Mercury in your 6th, expect revisions: a process may be reworked, a task list reshuffled, or an earlier decision revisited. Rather than pushing for a big new initiative, use today to optimise—fix a recurring error, reassign duties, or streamline communication channels. Feedback from colleagues or clients can be surprisingly useful if you listen for the pattern behind individual comments.

❤️ Love: Aquarius Moon brings a slightly detached, big-picture tone to relationships. If partnered, you may talk more about shared visions—where you see yourselves in a few years, what kind of social life you want, how you balance couple time with friends and community. Mars in your 4th can make you protective about home; channel that into constructive conversations about living arrangements instead of controlling behaviour. If single, you’re more likely to meet someone through friends, online spaces or group causes than in a one-to-one setting. Look for those who respect your independence but still show up consistently.

💰 Money: The 11th house is linked to gains from work and networks. You might hear news about incentives, bonuses, or results from a past effort. At the same time, Saturn in your 12th urges caution with impulsive lending, subscriptions, or vague shared expenses that quietly drain you. Use Virgo’s analytical power in your 6th to audit work-related spending—tools, commuting, small daily costs—and identify one leak you can plug. A realistic conversation with a friend or collaborator about money boundaries can prevent confusion later.

🧘 Advice: Be selective with your energy. Just because a group or goal is familiar doesn’t mean it still deserves prime space in your life; let your current values, not old promises, decide.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The invitation you decline today for the sake of your real priorities may turn out to be a much bigger yes to your future self.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Aquarius moves through your 10th house of karma and public standing, answering to Saturn in your 11th. Visibility increases, and with it, the weight of your choices. Sun and retrograde Mercury in Virgo occupy your 5th house, stirring a review of creative projects, children, and the risks you take for joy. Venus, your ruler, travelling through Libra in your 6th, seeks harmony in daily routines and work relationships. Overall, it’s a day to align ambition with authentic expression, not just obligation.

💼 Career: The 10th-house Moon often corresponds with being noticed—by bosses, clients, or the wider world. Even routine actions may carry extra impact, so act as if people are paying attention, because they likely are. Saturn’s influence from your 11th ties today’s efforts to longer-term rewards: committee roles, leadership in teams, or strategic alliances. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 5th, a past idea or proposal could resurface, this time ready to be refined and presented more elegantly. This is strong energy for polishing a pitch, updating a portfolio, or reshaping a project so it feels both more professional and more you.

❤️ Love: Under today’s sky, you’re less interested in drama and more in whether your love life reflects your true talents and joy. If partnered, shared hobbies, creative collaboration, or time spent encouraging each other’s passion projects can bring warmth back into the connection. Having fun together matters as much as problem-solving. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who notices and appreciates your gifts—your cooking, your art, your way with words. A reconnect with a past crush or an old friend could feel tempting; take your time to see whether there’s real growth, not just nostalgia.

💰 Money: Aquarius at the top of your chart nudges you to consider unconventional paths to income—consulting, group ventures, or using technology more strategically. At the same time, Virgo in your 5th encourages you to review spending on leisure, children and speculative ventures. Are these outlays supporting genuine creativity, or simply filling gaps in satisfaction elsewhere? You might decide to put structure around a hobby that could earn a little, or cap a type of frivolous spending that no longer feels worth it.

🧘 Advice: Let your ambitions be shaped by what feels creatively alive, not only by what seems impressive on paper. When your pride and your joy line up, effort feels lighter.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The small professional choice that honours your natural talents today can quietly shift your entire trajectory over time.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Aquarius lighting up your 9th house of dharma, higher learning and distant horizons, your mind tilts toward the big picture. Saturn there urges you to turn vague ideals into concrete plans. Sun and your ruler, retrograde Mercury, in Virgo activate your 4th house of home and inner foundations, bringing a reviewing energy to domestic matters and emotional roots. Mars in Cancer in your 2nd sharpens your focus on earnings and self-worth. This is a day to reconsider where you come from and where you’re heading, practically, not just philosophically.

💼 Career: The 9th-house Moon favours work involving teaching, publishing, law, travel, or cross-cultural connections. You may feel pulled to explore training, certifications or relocations, but Saturn’s hand suggests taking a realistic approach—research requirements, timelines and costs. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 4th, working from home, family businesses, or real estate-related tasks may need attention or revision. A past professional decision about your base of operations—office choice, city, or living arrangement—could be up for reconsideration. Use your natural versatility to sketch multiple scenarios, then filter them through what truly feels stable.

❤️ Love: Emotional security and shared beliefs matter more than usual today. If partnered, you may revisit conversations about living situations, family involvement, or how your philosophies align—around money, children, or lifestyle. The tone is less fiery and more thoughtful if you allow space for each person’s history. If single, you could connect with someone from a different background or through study and travel-related environments. Slow-burn connections that grow from shared curiosity are favoured over whirlwind attractions.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd can boost initiative around income but also trigger impatience with your financial situation. Channel that energy into constructive action—negotiating a rate, following up on an unpaid invoice, or identifying skills you can monetise—rather than impulsive purchases. Virgo in your 4th highlights home-related costs: rent, repairs, family support. It’s a good time to revisit a past decision about housing or shared expenses and see if an adjustment could bring more peace.

🧘 Advice: Let your restlessness point you toward structured growth. Craving a change of scenery or worldview is valid; grounding those urges in a step-by-step plan makes them sustainable.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The belief you quietly update today about what “home” must look like may open doors to a future you hadn’t considered possible.
cancer:

leo:

Mars in Cancer in your 12th stirs hidden frustrations or old resentments, making it extra important to stay conscious of what’s really driving your reactions. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 2nd, reconsider how you price your work or how you advocate for your value. Past compensation agreements or role descriptions might be up for revision. Come prepared with facts: contributions you’ve made, results achieved, and current market standards.

If partnered, you may discuss practical aspects of commitment: finances, shared responsibilities, or timelines for future plans. The key is to keep ego out of it and treat it as co-designing a structure that supports you both. If single, you’re more drawn to people who show reliability and emotional steadiness than to flashy charm. A conversation with someone who sees you in a more complex, human light—not just as a performer—could be quietly significant.

💰 Money: Virgo’s influence in your 2nd house encourages detailed budgeting and sorting out what you truly value. A past financial decision—such as a subscription, a side gig, or an informal loan—might need to be revisited. Aquarius Moon in the 7th connects your finances to others: shared ventures, fee splits, or agreements with business partners. This is a good time to update contracts so they reflect current realities rather than old assumptions.

🧘 Advice: Let your pride back you in setting fair terms instead of keeping you stuck in old ones. You don’t have to prove your worth through over-giving.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you calmly redraw around what you’re willing to give today can become the quiet turning point in how respected you feel tomorrow.
